EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 378 February 29, 1972
CREATING THE PHILIPPINE TOURIST BOARD
WHEREAS, there is need to coordinate efforts in the development and promotion of tourism in the
Philippines, and to involve all entities directly or indirectly connected with tourism so as to provide a
wholesome atmosphere for tourists in the Philippines;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do hereby create the
Philippine Tourist Board composed of the following:
Commissioner of Tourism
President, Philippine Tourist & Travel Association
Vice-Chairman
Commissioner of Immigration
Commissioner of Customs
Director, Bureau of Quarantine
Director, Civil Aeronautics Administration
Director, Civil Aeronautics Board
Manager, Manila International Airport
Director, Parks and Wildlife Office
Administrator, NACIDA
Chief, METROCOM
President, Philippine Chamber of Tourism
President, Associated Hotels of the Philippines
President, Hotels & Restaurant Association of the Philippines
President, Advertising Council of the Philippines
President, Philippine Press Institute
President, Association of Tour Operators of the Philippines
President, Philippine Society of Travel Agencies
President, Taxicab Operators of the Philippines
President, Bus Operators Association of the Philippines
President, Hunting and Fishing Association
President, Chamber of Cottage Industries
President, Airlines Operators of the Philippines
President of the Jaycees, Rotary and Lions Clubs in the Philippines
Representative of the Mayor, Manila
Representative of the Mayor, Pasay
Representative of the Mayor, Makati
Representative of the Mayor, Quezon City
The Board shall serve as an advisory body to establish the proper direction, the long-term and short-term
objectives, the standards, and to recommend the necessary legislation, towards the advancement of tourism in
the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
